final: SELECT state, AVG(group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(count_overall_ratio) AS average_count_divided_by_overall_average, AVG(count_total_ratio) AS average_count_divided_by_total_sum FROM (SELECT college_state AS state, group_count, group_count / overall_average AS count_overall_ratio, group_count / total_sum AS count_total_ratio FROM (SELECT college_id, college_state, COUNT(*) AS group_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS overall_average, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_sum FROM player_college JOIN college ON player_college.college_id = college.college_id GROUP BY player_college.college_id, college_state)) GROUP BY state
